notes: Debug and release variants share the exact applicationId com.codex.zhou; the bootstrap is compiled for this package id. The private Codex runtime excludes termux-tools/termux-am app-launching helpers and disables Git GUI/gitk, git-svn and git-p4 integrations to avoid optional Tcl/Tk/X11, Perl/Subversion and Python build chains. Core Git, HTTPS remote operations, OpenSSL and libcurl remain enabled; Bash command-not-found integration is optional and guarded.
